response.original_title: Sokoł – P.S. zu einem Kapitel unserer Geschichte
response.overview: The Sokoł Association, founded in 1920, was the most progressive organization within the Sorbian national movement until its dissolution in 1933, which was forced under pressure from the Nazis. From its beginnings as an insignificant sports association, the Sokoł, in cooperation with similar associations in neighboring Slavic countries, developed into an active center for the defense of democratic rights and against burgeoning fascist tendencies.
response.title: Sokoł - A Postscript to the Annals of Our History
